questions.question: To drive
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Ajaa' means to drive a vehicle.

questions.question: Down / Downstairs
questions.explanation: 'Alhaalla' indicates being down or downstairs.

questions.question: To start / begin
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Aloittaa' means to start or initiate something.

questions.question: Degree (temperature/angle)
questions.explanation: 'Aste' means a degree, commonly used for temperature.
questions.example: Ulkona on tänään kaksikymmentä astetta pakkasta.

questions.question: Sun
questions.explanation: 'Aurinko' means the sun.

questions.question: Yesterday
questions.explanation: 'Eilen' means yesterday.

questions.question: First snow
questions.explanation: 'Ensilumi' combines 'ensi' (first) and 'lumi' (snow).
questions.example: Lapset ovat iloisia, kun ensilumi sataa maahan.

questions.question: To search / look for
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Etsiä' means to search or look for something (+ Partitive).

questions.question: To apply for / fetch
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Hakea' means to fetch, collect, or apply for.

questions.question: Skirt
questions.explanation: 'Hame' means skirt.
questions.example: Hänellä on päällään kaunis punainen hame.

questions.question: Hobby
questions.explanation: 'Harrastus' means a hobby or pastime.

questions.question: To ski
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Hiihtää' specifically means cross-country skiing.

questions.question: Lift / Elevator
questions.explanation: 'Hissi' means an elevator or lift.

questions.question: Pants / Trousers
questions.explanation: 'Housut' is a plural noun meaning pants or trousers.

questions.question: Tomorrow
questions.explanation: 'Huomenna' means tomorrow.

questions.question: In a good mood
questions.explanation: 'Hyvällä tuulella' is an idiom meaning in a good mood or good spirits.
questions.example: Olen hyvällä tuulella, koska aurinko paistaa.

questions.question: In the evening
questions.explanation: 'Illalla' means during the evening time.

questions.question: Without
questions.explanation: 'Ilman' means without and requires the partitive case (+ Partitive).
questions.example: En halua lähteä ulos ilman takkia.

questions.question: To celebrate
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Juhlia' means to celebrate or party.
questions.example: Me aiomme juhlia hänen syntymäpäiväänsä viikonloppuna.

questions.question: Summer
questions.explanation: 'Kesä' means summer.

questions.question: Spring
questions.explanation: 'Kevät' means spring.
questions.example: Keväällä luonto herää ja herää eloon.

questions.question: Size
questions.explanation: 'Koko' can mean size (genitive: koon) or whole/entire.

questions.question: Rubber boots
questions.explanation: 'Kumisaappaat' means rubber boots/wellies used for rainy weather.
questions.example: Tarvitset kumisaappaat, koska ulkona on märkää.

questions.question: To knit
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Kutoa' means to knit or weave.

questions.question: Gift / Present
questions.explanation: 'Lahja' means a gift or present.

questions.question: Mittens
questions.explanation: 'Lapaset' are mittens (where fingers are together except the thumb).

questions.question: Too / Too much / Excessively
questions.explanation: 'Liian' means too (adverb) and 'liikaa' means too much.

questions.question: Dirty
questions.explanation: 'Likainen' means dirty or soiled.

questions.question: To end / finish
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Loppua' means to end, run out, or conclude.

questions.question: Snow
questions.explanation: 'Lumi' means snow.
questions.example: Maassa on jo paljon valkoista lunta.

questions.question: To think / suppose
questions.explanation: Type 3 verb. 'Luulla' means to assume, suppose, or think incorrectly.

questions.question: Contactless payment
questions.explanation: 'Lähimaksu' means contactless payment using a card or phone device.

questions.question: Thermometer
questions.explanation: 'Lämpömittari' means thermometer (literally heat-meter).
questions.example: Katso lämpömittarista, kuinka kylmä ulkona on.

questions.question: To find
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Löytää' means to find or discover.

questions.question: Strawberry
questions.explanation: 'Mansikka' means strawberry.
questions.example: Suomalaiset mansikat ovat kesällä erittäin makeita.

questions.question: To travel
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Matkustaa' means to travel or journey.

questions.question: Cottage / Cabin
questions.explanation: 'Mökki' means a summer cottage or log cabin.
questions.example: Meillä on pieni hirsimökki järven rannalla.

questions.question: To look like / show
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. Used with 'miltä' (Ablative) to mean 'look like'.
questions.example: Tuo takki näyttää hyvältä sinun päälläsi.

questions.question: To sunbathe / take sun
questions.explanation: 'Ottaa aurinkoa' means to sunbathe or catch sun rays.

questions.question: To shine (sun) / bake / fry
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Paistaa' is used for the sun shining or for frying/baking food.

questions.question: Shirt
questions.explanation: 'Paita' means a shirt or top garment.

questions.question: Freezing weather / Frost
questions.explanation: 'Pakkanen' means sub-zero freezing weather or frost.
questions.example: Ulkona on kova pakkanen, laita pipo päähän.

questions.question: Mirror
questions.explanation: 'Peili' means mirror.
questions.example: Katson peiliin ennen kuin lähden ulos.

questions.question: Dark
questions.explanation: 'Pimeä' means dark or dim.

questions.question: Beanie / Winter knit cap
questions.explanation: 'Pipo' means a knit winter cap or beanie.
questions.example: Älä unohda laittaa pipoa, ulkona tuulee.

questions.question: To fall
questions.explanation: Type 4 verb. 'Pudota' means to fall down or drop.

questions.question: To put on clothes / dress
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Pukea' or 'pukea päälle' means to dress or put on.

questions.question: Sweater / Pullover / Blouse
questions.explanation: 'Pusero' refers to a sweater, jersey, or blouse.

questions.question: Tree / Wood
questions.explanation: 'Puu' means tree or the material wood.

questions.question: Garden
questions.explanation: 'Puutarha' means garden or orchard.

questions.question: To rain / snow
questions.explanation: Type 1 impersonal verb. Used for precipitation (sataa vettä = it rains; sataa lunta = it snows).

questions.question: To fit / suit / agree
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Sopia' means to fit, be suitable for, or agree on something.

questions.question: Suitable / Fitting
questions.explanation: 'Sopiva' is an adjective meaning suitable, convenient, or appropriate.

questions.question: Gloves (with separate fingers)
questions.explanation: 'Sormikkaat' refers to gloves with five separate finger slots.

questions.question: To try on (clothes)
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Sovittaa' means to test or try on garments.

questions.question: Autumn / Fall
questions.explanation: 'Syksy' means autumn or fall.

questions.question: Weather
questions.explanation: 'Sää' means weather status (synonym: ilma).

questions.question: To save
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Säästää' means to economize or save money/resources.

questions.question: Jacket / Coat
questions.explanation: 'Takki' means a coat, blazer, or jacket.
questions.example: Ota paksu takki mukaan, ulkona on kylmä.

questions.question: Winter
questions.explanation: 'Talvi' means winter.
questions.example: Talvella Suomessa on paljon lunta ja pakkasta.

questions.question: To text / send SMS
questions.explanation: Type 4 verb. 'Tekstata' means to type and send text messages.

questions.question: Order / Subscription
questions.explanation: 'Tilaus' means a product order or commercial subscription.
questions.example: Lehden tilaus maksaa viisikymmentä euroa vuodessa.

questions.question: Product
questions.explanation: 'Tuote' (genitive: tuotteen) means a manufactured product or item.

questions.question: Wind
questions.explanation: 'Tuuli' means wind.

questions.question: To blow / be windy
questions.explanation: Type 3 verb. Used impersonally: 'Ulkona tuulee' = It is windy outside.

questions.question: Thunderstorm
questions.explanation: 'Ukkonen' means thunderstorm or thunder.
questions.example: Kesällä ukkonen nousee usein kuuman päivän jälkeen.

questions.question: To choose / select
questions.explanation: Type 5 verb. 'Valita' means to choose, elect, or select.
questions.example: Sinun täytyy valita joko punainen tai sininen paita.

questions.question: Bright / Light / Well-lit
questions.explanation: 'Valoisa' means bright, light, or filled with light.
questions.example: Tässä asunnossa on isot ikkunat ja se on erittäin valoisa.

questions.question: Warehouse / Storage room
questions.explanation: 'Varasto' means a warehouse, storeroom, or supply stock.

questions.question: Seasons
questions.explanation: 'Vuodenajat' means the seasons of the year (literally year-times).
questions.example: Suomessa on neljä hyvin erilaista vuodenaikaa.
